call_purpose: You wanted help with lesson videos that keep loading and never play for some of your students, mostly on their phones.

covered.text: We opened the lesson link you shared on Chrome, Safari and a phone, and the video played fine each time, so we could not reproduce the problem from our side; it is not yet resolved.

customer_next_steps.text: Ask one affected student to record a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.

support_next_steps.text: We will raise this with our technical team and get back to you; we are not able to confirm a timeline yet.
